regulatory_model.quote: All privately employed agents, except those who have been granted a waiver from compliance herewith by the commissioner who, as an incidence to their employment, carry a lethal weapon shall be required to attend the program established by subsection (a) of this section in accordance with the requirements or regulations established by the commissioner and, upon satisfactory completion of such program, shall be entitled to certification by the commissioner.

is_mandatory.quote: Any privately employed agent who in the course of his employ carries a lethal weapon, and who fails to comply with subsection (b) of section 4 or with subsection (a) of section 8 of this act, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor

definition_quote.value: "Privately employed agents" include any person employed for the purpose of providing watch guard, protective patrol, detective or criminal investigative services either for another for a fee or for his employer.

lethal_weapon_definition_excludes.quote: The chemical mace or any similar substance shall not be considered as "lethal weapons" for the purposes of this act.

approved_firearm_type.value: powder actuated firearm approved by the commissioner
approved_firearm_type.quote: he shall carry only a powder actuated firearm approved by the commissioner

inoperative_firearm_prohibited.quote: No individual certified under this act shall carry an inoperative or model firearm while employed

physical_psychological_screening_require.quote: To implement and administer or approve physical and psychological testing and screening of the candidate for the purpose of barring from the program those not physically or mentally fit to handle lethal weapons.

criminal_history_disqualifier.value: convicted of or has pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to a crime of violence
criminal_history_disqualifier.quote: the commissioner determines that the applicant is eighteen years of age and has not been convicted of or has not pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to a crime of violence

fingerprint_check_required.quote: The fingerprints of the applicant shall be examined by the Pennsylvania State Police and the Federal Bureau of Investigation to determine if he has been convicted of or has pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to a crime of violence.

certificate_must_be_carried_on_duty.quote: Every certified individual shall carry his wallet or billfold size certificate on his person as identification during the time when he is on duty or going to and from duty and carrying a lethal weapon.

certificate_format.value: wallet or billfold size copy of the certificate with photograph of the individual
certificate_format.quote: The commissioner shall furnish to each individual satisfactorily completing the program, an appropriate wallet or billfold size copy of the certificate, which shall include a photograph of the individual thereon.

employer_discharge_notification_required.quote: Whenever an employer of a privately employed agent subject to the provisions of this act discharges him for cause, the employer shall notify the commissioner of such within five days of the discharge.

employer_program_participation_prohibite.quote: Except for colleges and universities, no nongovernment employer of a privately employed agent who, as an incidence to his employment, carries a lethal weapon, shall own, operate, or otherwise participate in, directly or indirectly, the establishment or administration of the program established by subsection (a) of this section.

retired_officer_expedited_certification.quote: A nondisability retired police officer of a Pennsylvania municipality or the Pennsylvania State Police shall be initially certified under this act, and need not meet the training and qualification standards or physical and psychological qualifications hereunder

retired_officer_minimum_service_years.quote: if he was a full-time police officer for at least twenty years, retired in good standing

retired_officer_post_retirement_window_y.quote: has assumed the duties of a privately employed agent on or before three years from the date of his retirement. If a retired police officer commences his duties as a privately employed agent after three years from the date of his retirement he must meet the physical and psychological requirements

active_officer_training_waiver_available.quote: All active police officers subject to the training provisions of the act of June 18, 1974 (P.L.359, No.120), referred to as the Municipal Police Education and Training Law, shall be granted a waiver of the training requirements of this act

firearms_qualification_exam_interval_yea.quote: the successful completion of a biennial firearms qualification examination administered by their respective police agency
